settings.label: Logo image
settings.info: Optional — falls back to the shop name rendered as a bold wordmark ("MODIX."), matching the master demo.

settings.content: Defaults to the fixed MODIX brand tokens (White / Off-white / Charcoal / Slate / Electric Blue) used throughout the master design. Adjust only if departing from brand guidelines.

settings.label: Heading font
settings.info: Defaults to Space Grotesk, matching the MODIX demo.

settings.label: Body / UI font
settings.info: Defaults to Inter, matching the MODIX demo.

settings.content: Prices, SKUs, spec chips and mono labels use JetBrains Mono, loaded directly from Google Fonts in layout/theme.liquid (Shopify's font_picker only covers the two settings above).

settings.label: Free shipping threshold
settings.info: Amount (in your shop's currency major units) at which the free-shipping progress bar in the cart drawer/cart page reaches 100%. The MODIX demo uses ₹2,999. Shopify's own shipping settings (Settings > Shipping and delivery) govern what's actually charged at checkout; this setting only drives the visual progress bar.

settings.label: Use cart drawer
settings.info: When enabled, adding a product opens the slide-in cart drawer, matching the demo. The dedicated cart page (/cart) is always available.

settings.label: Default meta description
settings.default: Shop Modix smartphones, laptops, wireless audio, smart home devices and wearables — precision engineering, real specs, and a 1-2 year warranty on every product.
settings.info: Used as a fallback on any page that has no page-specific description (product/collection descriptions are preferred automatically when present).

settings.label: Default social sharing image
settings.info: Used for Open Graph / Twitter previews when a page has no more specific image (e.g. no product/collection image).

settings.content: Shopify has no native wishlist object. Wishlist state is stored client-side in the shopper's browser via localStorage, keyed by product handle and exposed as window.Modix.wishlist (see assets/theme.js). It is per-browser, not synced to the customer account.
